Choose earbuds by fit, controls and daily use

A secure fit is part of the sound and noise-control decision

Check the supplied tip sizes and the retailer's return conditions for opened in-ear products. Active noise cancellation, passive isolation and transparency mode are distinct features. Do not assume one set fits every ear or that a noise-cancellation claim proves comfort on a long call. A lighter bud and a smaller charging case may matter more for everyday pocket use.

Separate earbud runtime from case top-ups

Compare playback time with the features you will enable, then check the extra charges available from the case. Confirm your phone's supported features, multipoint behavior and charging connector. Water resistance applies only within the exact rating and instructions; the case may have a different rating.
